verdicts.reason: Both crop away the brush/palette frame that defined the original and add an odd pale translucent band with hard seams across the middle. A keeps the three boxes at their original small size, so the title block floats in a large empty band. B scales the boxes up for better presence, but the KIT box is narrower and offset from the two above, and it runs past the band's lower seam. Its gaps are also uneven, and the off-centre text inside each box is more obvious at this size. That makes B look sloppier, so A is marginally better.
